description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelSelectAllButton class, which extends SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton to generate an HTML form button labeled 'Select All' for use within SugarCRM/SuiteCRM subpanels.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelSelectAllButton
classes.description: A PHP class that generates a 'Select All' HTML button for subpanels in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, extending the base button class for subpanel top buttons.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Returns an HTML form with a submit button labeled 'Select All' which posts to a specified module action URL.
